title: hedera helix f. minima
intro: Hedera helix f. minima, commonly known as the dwarf English ivy, is a low-growing, evergreen climber plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and supporting cardiovascular health, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The therapeutic actions of Hedera helix f. minima include sedative and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate stress, anxiety, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
